title: StreetWorks Celebrates a Successful Monterey Car Week 2023
excerpt: StreetWorks Exotics, a leader in classic and exotic car restoration, is thrilled to announce its participation and successes at the prestigious Monterey Car Week 2023.

blocks.html: StreetWorks Exotics, a leader in classic and exotic car restoration, is thrilled to announce its participation and successes at the prestigious Monterey Car Week 2023. This year’s event was particularly special, as it featured a landmark invitation and award for one of our meticulously restored exotic vehicles.
Lamborghini Espada 2 Restored by StreetWorks Invited to Compete at Pebble Beach:

Our comprehensive restoration of the Lamborghini Espada 2, completed a few years ago, earned a coveted invitation to compete in the Lamborghini Anniversary class at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. This accolade underscores our commitment to quality and craftsmanship in high-end Italian car restoration.
The week began with the Tour d’Elegance. Despite our team having the usual pre-event jitters, the Espada performed flawlessly, setting the stage for an exciting week ahead.

Our most recent project, a De Tomaso Mangusta restoration, was featured at the Quail Motorsports Gathering. Additionally, several of our clients showcased their cars at this event, including an Iso Grifo 7 litre, a Jensen C-V8, and a Maserati Ghibli, all beautifully restored by our expert team.

Sunday marked the pinnacle of the event with the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. The Rosso Granada Lamborghini Espada, the first of its kind to grace the Pebble Beach show field, captured the audience’s attention. We were thrilled to take home 2nd place among the fierce competition, finishing just behind a Lamborghini Miura, which is nearly impossible to beat. This achievement is a testament to our dedication and passion for exotic car restoration.

“We are incredibly proud of our accomplishments at Monterey Car Week 2023,” said Matt Backhaus, owner of StreetWorks. “The recognition of our work on the Lamborghini Espada at such a distinguished event is a significant milestone for our team. We look forward to continuing our tradition of excellence in future events.”
We are already gearing up for next year’s show and are excited to bring more restored marvels to the forefront. Stay tuned for updates!
